rubrics.name: General Response Quality
rubrics.description: A general-purpose rubric for evaluating any AI response

items.label: Addresses the prompt
items.description: Does the response actually answer what was asked?

items.label: Factual accuracy
items.description: Is the information provided correct?

items.label: Well-structured
items.description: Is the response organized and easy to follow?

items.label: Appropriate length
items.description: Is the response the right length for the task?

items.label: Appropriate tone
items.description: Does the tone match what was requested or expected?

items.label: Syntactically valid
items.description: Does the code parse without errors?

items.label: Solves the problem
items.description: Does the code actually solve what was asked?

items.label: Handles edge cases
items.description: Which edge cases are handled?

items.label: Readable code
items.description: Is the code easy to understand?

items.label: Well-commented
items.description: Are there helpful comments where needed?

rubrics.name: Creative Writing
rubrics.description: For evaluating creative or stylistic writing

items.label: Matches requested style
items.description: Does it match the genre, voice, or style that was asked for?

items.label: Engaging
items.description: Is it interesting to read?

items.label: Technically competent
items.description: Is the prose well-crafted (grammar, flow, word choice)?

items.label: Creative elements present
items.description: What creative elements are included?

items.label: Complete piece
items.description: Does it feel finished and self-contained?

rubrics.name: Instruction Following
rubrics.description: For evaluating how well the model follows specific instructions

items.label: Followed format
items.description: Did it use the requested format (JSON, markdown, etc)?

items.label: Constraints respected
items.description: Did it respect length limits, word counts, or other constraints?

items.label: All parts addressed
items.description: Did it address all parts of a multi-part question?

items.label: No unwanted extras
items.description: Did it avoid adding things that weren't asked for?

rubrics.name: Quick Yes/No
rubrics.description: Simple pass/fail evaluation for quick checks

items.label: Acceptable response
items.description: Is this response acceptable for the task?

rubrics.name: On a scale of 1-10 how well does this response meet the requirements of the prompt?
Instruction following
rubrics.description: How well did the model follow the instructions in the prompt?
